generate_model_response.description: Ask Claude to write, summarise or answer something, and get its reply.

mock_response.response_text: Here is a thoughtful response to your question about artificial intelligence and its applications in modern software development.

generate_model_response.name: generate_model_response

parameters.description: The message or question to send to Claude.
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.description: Which Claude model to use. Defaults to claude-opus-4-8.
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: Maximum number of tokens Claude may generate in its response. Raise it for longer replies. Leave blank to use the default (4096).
parameters.name: max_tokens

start_agent.description: Hand a task to an agent you've set up in the Claude Console. It works on its own in Anthropic's cloud, so follow this step with 'Wait for a Claude agent's reply' to get its answer.
start_agent.name: start_agent

parameters.description: The agent to give the task to.
parameters.name: agent

parameters.description: Where the agent works: the environment sets what it can install and which websites it can reach.
parameters.name: environment

parameters.description: What you want the agent to do, written as you would to a colleague. Say what a good result looks like.
parameters.name: task

session_id.description: The ID of the agent's session (starts with sesn_). Give it to 'Wait for a Claude agent's reply'.

session_status.description: Whether the agent is running yet.

wait_for_agent.description: Wait until a Claude agent has finished its task, then get its reply. If the agent asks permission to use a tool, this step declines, as nobody is there to approve it.

mock_response.reply: I checked all 12 links on the page. Two are broken.

wait_for_agent.name: wait_for_agent

parameters.description: The session ID from 'Start a Claude agent' (starts with sesn_).
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.description: Fail if the agent is still working this long after it started. Defaults to 60.
parameters.name: max_wait_minutes

reply.description: The agent's last message, or empty if it finished without writing one.

session_id.description: The ID of the agent's session.

session_status.description: Always finished: the agent is done.

description: Ask Claude, Anthropic's AI assistant, to write, summarise or answer, or hand tasks to your Claude agents.
